title: Inspiration of Scripture
definition: The inspiration of Scripture means that God breathed out His Word through human authors so that Scripture is truly God's Word while also written through real human writers in history.
summary: Scripture is not merely human religious insight. God superintended the writing of His Word so that what Scripture teaches is trustworthy, authoritative, and profitable for the people of God.
christFocus: Christ affirmed the reliability and divine authority of Scripture. The inspired Word points to Him, records His saving work, and gives the church the apostolic witness to His person, death, resurrection, and return.

studySections.heading: God-Breathed Scripture
studySections.content: The phrase God-breathed teaches that Scripture comes from God. The Bible is not merely about God; it is God's own self-revealing Word.

studySections.heading: Human Authors and Divine Source
studySections.content: The writers of Scripture used their own language, style, background, and circumstances. Yet the Holy Spirit carried them along so that the written Word is what God intended to give.

studySections.heading: Inspiration and Trustworthiness
studySections.content: Because Scripture is inspired by God, believers can trust its message, submit to its teaching, and rely on its promises.

studySections.heading: Inspiration Serves Salvation and Discipleship
studySections.content: The inspired Scriptures make the wisdom of God known, bear witness to Christ, and equip believers for every good work.
